name: Shadow Spears (9-10)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-19: Mean Streets of Shadow Absalom

disable: DC 30 Thievery check (trained) to remove pieces from the mosaic without triggering the magic or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune

items.name: Barrage of Spears
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks upon the mosaic.

---

Effect The trap shoots a fusillade of shadow-wreathed spears out of the walls, making a Strike against each creature in area A1. Creatures who take damage from the spears must succeed at a DC 28 Will save save or become Doomed 1 as the spears tear off part of their shadow.

text: Invisible runes are concealed within an elaborate light-woven floor mosaic.
